newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil firms on futures but market quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil firms on futures but market quiet.

text.p: NWE gas oil firmed slightly on Thursday in line with futures but the market was quiet due to the public holiday across much of Germany, traders said.
They said the absence of many Germany players due to the Corpus Christi holiday had dampened trade.
"It's not going to be much better tomorrow, they'll probably extend the holiday into the weekend," said one trader.
Prices were given a small boost by futures. June IPE gas oil closed $1.25 higher at $174.25 a tonne.

A refiner sold a parcel of swiss specification heating oil at June IPE +$2.50 fob ARA in early trade for first half June delivery and a parcel of storage heating oil material at June IPE +$1.25 fob ARA.
Diesel barges were done at around June IPE +$9.0 fob ARA.
Traders said diesel supplies in the region were beginning to look sloppy as some players import Mediterranean material into the region.
A Scandinavian player sold 10,000 tonne cargo of German DIN material into Germany at June IPE +$2.0 cif NWE.
